reason: A DSH Web UI customization plugin focused on color themes, local background images, persistent appearance settings, and VSCode-style draggable panel layouts.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供配色主题、本地背景图、可拖拽停靠的卡片布局及插件面板管理功能。
summaries.en: Customizes the DSH Web UI with color themes, local background images, draggable dockable card layouts, and plugin panel management.

capabilities: Changes the DSH Web UI color themes and visual styling
Supports local background image upload with client-side compression
Provides draggable, dockable, floating, and resizable panel layouts
Stores appearance and layout preferences in browser localStorage
Provides a unified plugin panel with tabs and search
